material_findings.finding: Current strict responsibility split treats legacy gaudi-kernels and Bridge as permanent boundaries; this conflicts with user's latest request for an independent bottom-up system.

Hardware tests use ExecutionEngine. It does not invoke UnifiedRegionLowerer or GenerationEpochTracker. CompiledRegionExecutor is a separate header implementation and is not exercised by those hardware tests.
reset and workspace growth are not tied to in-flight leases. Registry handles, binding tables and allocations are borrowed by execution; safe lifetime/reclamation is left to callers.

External producer notification only increments an epoch; replay waits on comm_stream regardless of which stream actually produced the input. There is no retained producer event per external dependency.
An error after a submitted prefix throws before commit_step; no failed/poisoned state or partial-submission accounting prevents replay of the same logical step.
Fixed 575 budget and 2 chunks per recipe remain a measured-workload assumption. Credit manager is a host admission policy above Synapse, not ownership of the SDK's internal resource pool.

LegacyAddressEventMap stores pointers to vector elements. A later push_back reallocates the vector, leaving events_by_addr pointers dangling. ASan reproduces heap-use-after-free on the second producer registration. This invalidates reliance on the current RT-2 baseline benchmark until corrected.

next_boundary: Freeze device/buffer/recipe ownership and submission-completion/error contracts first; unify the executor; then build reusable Synapse graph/subgraph construction, operator layer and model execution upward. Legacy repositories are source/migration/reference assets rather than permanent architectural boundaries.
